note: Hand-curated, source-cited documented cascade chains for Chennai. Each chain has an ordered tank list (with OSM IDs resolved where the current OpenStreetMap extract carries the name) and a directed edge set drawn from the cited source. Used by the cascade health scorer at neer-vazhvu-api/app/cascade/health.py to enrich auto-derived cascades. Tanks with osm_id=null could not be matched against the OSM extract under any of the searched name variants and are interpreted by the scorer as a 'missing from OSM' signal contributing to the cascade's fragility score.

cascades.name: Korttalaiyar four-reservoir diversion chain
cascades.narrative: Chennai's canonical engineered supply chain: Korttalaiyar river surplus diverted via the 1870 Tamaraipakkam Anicut into Cholavaram, then Red Hills, with Poondi reservoir (1944) added as upstream storage feeding Cholavaram via the 1972 Poondi Canal. The chain has been the city's drinking-water spine for 150+ years.

source.citation: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board, Historical Background; CMDA Second Master Plan Vol III Chapter 7 (Water Supply Infrastructure).

cascades.name: Ambattur-Korattur-Retteri industrial-zone cascade
cascades.narrative: Three large lakes in north Chennai with surplus flowing east-southeast through what was historically a kanmoi network and is now a hybrid of natural surplus channels and engineered drains (notably the Lucas TVS canal). All three appear in OSM as ~100-200 ha polygons. Drains ultimately into the Otteri Nullah and the Buckingham Canal.

source.citation: Wikipedia: Ambattur Lake, Korattur Lake, Retteri, Otteri Nullah; DT Next 2023 surplus-diversion coverage; Urban Acres Chennai water diversion article.

cascades.name: Sembakkam-Pallikaranai south-Chennai cluster
cascades.narrative: Surface runoff from the Pachamalai hills cascades through Chitlapakkam, Sembakkam, Nanmangalam, and Keelkattalai before discharging into the Pallikaranai marsh - the Ramsar Site #2481 (designated 2022). One of the most-documented Chennai cascade narratives because of the marshland advocacy literature.

source.citation: Care Earth Trust et al. Comprehensive Management Plan for Pallikaranai Marsh 2014-2019; Citizen Matters 'Reviving Sembakkam Lake'; The Nature Conservancy Sembakkam programme.

tanks_in_order.name: Pallikaranai Marsh
tanks_in_order.notes: OSM polygon 154089347 is only one fragment ('Thamarai Kulam'); the full Ramsar relation is OSM relation 15046539 and totals ~700 ha residual from ~2650 ha historical.

edges.notes: Now via cut-and-cover drain; original natural channel encroached.

cascades.name: Veeranam long-distance supply scheme
cascades.narrative: Inter-basin transfer from the Cauvery system: Stanley Reservoir at Mettur via Lower Anicut + Vadavar Canal to Veeranam Lake in Cuddalore district, then via 230 km of MS pipeline to Chennai's Porur distribution station. Commissioned 2004; conceived 1967. Included here as an engineered NEGATIVE-CONTROL case to distinguish documented engineered transfers from algorithm-predicted natural cascades.

source.citation: Veeranam Lake Wikipedia entry; CMDA Second Master Plan Vol III Chapter 7; DT Next 2018 retrospective on Veeranam scheme.
